newsitem.title: INDIA: India's NLC plans new mine and power plant.
newsitem.headline: India's NLC plans new mine and power plant.

text.p: India's state-run Nevyeli Lignite Corporation (NLC) plans to open a new lignite mine and build a thermal power plant at a cost of 29.3 billion rupees ($820 million), its chairman was quoted as saying on Friday.

The Press Trust of India (PTI) said P.V. Bhupathy told a meeting to mark the 50th year of India's independence at Neyveli in the southern state of Tamil Nadu that the mine was expected to open in 2000 and the power plant a year later.
The new mine will cost 13.4 billion rupees ($375 million) and the power plant comprising two units of 210 megawatts (mw) each will cost 15.9 billion rupees, Bhupathy was quoted as saying.

Bhupathy said NLC would open another mine with a capacity to produce three million tonnes per year to meet the requirements of a 250 mw private sector power plant being built by a U.S. firm. PTI did not give details. ($1=35.7 rupees)
